notes.subject: ויבז
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'vayyibez' nĩ kũthingũra-kĩndũ-kĩhengereirie; gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũthia kĩrĩa kĩrutanagia maũndũ nĩ 'akenagĩrĩirie' — kĩhumo kĩa kĩngerekera thutha wa mĩario ĩrĩa ikuhĩrĩirie.

notes.subject: wayyiqtol cluster
notes.rationale: Mĩario ĩnya ya wayyiqtol (akĩrĩa, akĩnyua, akĩima, akĩthiĩ) nĩ mũhianĩre wa Kĩhibirania ũrotherie mũthingi wake ũkũhĩrĩirie — Gĩkũyũ gĩcokanagĩria na 'akĩ-'.

notes.subject: nao
notes.rationale: Kiugo gĩa kwĩhokia gĩongĩtwo mbere ya Ecau gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũthia, kũgeria wathani wa andũ-a-mũthenya ũrĩa Kĩhibirania kĩrĩ na hamwe na ũrĩa kĩhũthagĩra.

translation: Nĩrĩ Yaakobu aheire Ecau ngate na mũkoro wa mboco-ceci; nĩrĩa arĩa na kunyua, akĩima, akĩthiĩ; nao Ecau akenagĩrĩirie ⟨את⟩ kĩbangĩ kĩa mũciarĩ-wa-mbere.
